extends: FROZEN R1-002 1.0.0 and FROZEN R1-004 1.0.0; no prior artifact is edited

permissions.suppliers.read: Read supplier names, contacts, requisites and state; staff-only.
permissions.suppliers.write: Create, edit and archive suppliers; no offer or match authority.
permissions.suppliers.offers.read: Read offer revisions, acquisition costs, freshness and match history; staff-only.
permissions.suppliers.offers.write: Create, revise and archive offers; cannot approve or unlink a product match.
permissions.suppliers.matches.decide: Create one match proposal, approve/reject one proposal, or explicitly unlink one current match.

rules: Every new supplier permission is default-deny and only declared here; no wildcard or role-name checks.
R1-002 and R1-004 role templates are not expanded automatically. No RolePermission/UserRole grant is seeded or performed by this contract.
Normal R1-002 configurable RBAC remains the only grant path; the additive PermissionCode integration is OD-007A-06 and must be approved before implementation.
Offer read is intentionally separate from supplier read: acquisition costs and source history require both effective permissions for offer details/comparison.
Match actions require offer read, supplier read, the new decision permission, and both frozen catalog product/reference read permissions. A match permission alone never reveals offer or catalog data.
Audit details require audit.read plus the corresponding supplier/offer read permission; audit.read alone does not reveal restricted supplier objects.
No public endpoint, public DTO or unauthenticated cache contains supplier contact, offer, acquisition cost, provenance or match data.
